cases.description: Reproduce first, then repair version discovery and keep concrete and autoupdate entries aligned.
cases.prompt: The widget manifest's checkver stopped matching after upstream changed its release page, and the update workflow reports no version found. Explain how to repair it. This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No bucket checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the bucket files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Directs reproducing and classifying the failure before editing.
Repairs checkver and keeps the concrete URL/hash and the autoupdate template aligned.
Directs checking the real download rather than assuming the new URL pattern.
Finishes by directing scoop-verify for the readiness verdict.

cases.description: Handle all-zero hashes as placeholders, not as a verified state.
cases.prompt: A binary manifest has an all-zero architecture hash and a version of 2.0.0. Is it fine to leave as is, and how do I fix it? This is a desk exercise: do not edit the repo, run installs, or perform network requests. No bucket checkout is available in this session, so do not search for one: answer from the skill's guidance and name the bucket files, scripts and workflow jobs you would inspect. Answer concretely.

rubric_items.text: Recognizes the all-zero hash as a placeholder despite the nonzero version.
Replaces it only from the real downloaded asset and keeps autoupdate hash handling consistent.
Does not edit .gitignore or other template-managed files by hand.
Hands off to scoop-verify and marks Windows evidence pending when unavailable.
